sections.title: باب 1 — متن (13)

paras.text: … (Treasury). The financial year (which begins on first July and runs till thirtieth June) budget is presented in the National Assembly by the central Finance Minister. (The budget is the account of the government’s income and expenditure for one year.) The National Assembly has the power to change the budget, i.e. to increase or reduce it, and to approve or reject it, or approve it in its original form. Generally the national budget is approved with minor changes or in its original form. In the National Assembly there is a Public Accounts Committee consisting of members of the National Assembly. It is the responsibility of this committee to scrutinise the expenditure given in the budget and present a report to the assembly. (The government does not have the power to levy any tax without the permission of the assembly.) Keeping these unlimited financial powers in view it is said that the National Assembly is the guardian of the national treasury.

(بودیجه د یوه کال لپاره د حکومت د عاید او لګښت حساب ته ویل کېږي.) ملي شورا ته دا واک شته چې په بودیجه کې بدلون راولي، زیاتوالی یا کمښت پکې راولي، رد یې کړي یا په اصلي حالت یې تصویب کړي. عموماً ملي بودیجه له لږ بدلون سره یا په اصلي بڼه تصویبېږي. په ملي شورا کې د عامه حسابونو کمېټه وي چې د ملي شورا له غړو جوړه وي. د دې کمېټې مسؤلیت دی چې په بودیجه کې ورکړل شوي لګښتونه وڅېړي او شورا ته راپور وړاندې کړي. paras.text: (Under the Constitution of 1973 all powers regarding the administration of justice belong to the judiciary. The constitution has given Parliament the power to approve or not approve the appointment of judges nominated to the Supreme Court of Pakistan. The legislature, i.e. the National Assembly together with the Senate, can impeach the President of Pakistan, which is a judicial activity.)

This institution elects senators from Islamabad and its tribal members elect senators for the tribal areas. The National Assembly, Senate and provincial assemblies together elect the President of Pakistan. The Senate elects its Chairman and Deputy Chairman.)

paras.pashto: (ملي شورا د پاکستان لومړی وزیر ټاکي، یعنې د باور رایه ورکوي. د خپل سپیکر او مرستیال سپیکر د ټاکلو حق لري. دا اداره له اسلام اباد سناتوران ټاکي او قبایلي غړي یې د قبایلي سیمې لپاره سناتوران ټاکي. ملي شورا له سنا او ولایتي شوراګانو سره یوځای د پاکستان ولسمشر ټاکي. سنا خپل رییس او مرستیال رییس ټاکي.)

paras.text: According to the constitution, the right of change or amendment in the constitution belongs to Parliament. A two-thirds majority of the total members of the National Assembly is needed to amend the constitution, and when it is sent to the other house, a two-thirds majority of the total members is needed there too. This amending bill can be presented in either house. The people have an emotional relationship and hopes attached to the legislature. In this branch the members of the assembly fully raise public problems, and members bring the problems of their areas to the notice of the government. These are the most effective forum for speaking on public problems and national affairs, because all the ministers and the Prime Minister are present in it. Besides this it would not be wrong to call it a bridge of contact between the people and the government, because on the one hand they bring public problems to the government’s notice, and on the other hand they convey government activities to the people. The National Assembly can at any time, by withdrawing confidence from the cabinet and the Prime Minister, remove them. It can reject any government draft. It can remove its Speaker and Deputy Speaker with a simple majority of total members. It can bring a notice of disqualification of any of its members to the Speaker.

paras.pashto: د اساسي قانون له مخې په اساسي قانون کې د بدلون یا تعدیل حق پارلمان ته دی. د ملي شورا د ټولو غړو دوه پر درې اکثریت په اساسي قانون کې تعدیل کوي او بلې جرګې ته یې لېږي، هلته هم د ټولو غړو دوه پر درې اکثریت ته اړتیا وي. دا تعدیلي لایحه په هره جرګه کې وړاندې کېدای شي. خلک له مقننې سره احساساتي اړیکه او هیلې لري. د حکومت په دې څانګه کې غړي د خلکو ستونزې په بشپړه توګه یادوي او غړي د خپلو سیمو ستونزې حکومت ته رسوي. دا د ولسي ستونزو او ملي چارو پر سر د خبرو تر ټولو اغېزمن فورم دی ځکه په کې ټول وزیران او لومړی وزیر حاضر وي. سربېره پر دې، دې ته د خلکو او حکومت ترمنځ د اړیکې پل ویل بې‌ځایه نه دي، ځکه که له یوې خوا دوی ولسي ستونزې حکومت ته رسوي، نو له بلې خوا حکومتي فعالیتونه خلکو ته رسوي. ملي شورا هر وخت کولی شي پر کابینې او لومړي وزیر د بې‌باورۍ په رایه هغوی ګوښه کړي. کولی شي هر حکومتي مسوده رد کړي. خپل سپیکر او مرستیال سپیکر هم د ټولو غړو په ساده اکثریت لرې کولی شي. کولی شي د خپل هر غړي نااهلي د سپیکر خبرتیا ته راوړي.

… (Treasury). The financial year (which begins on first July and runs till thirtieth June) budget is presented in the National Assembly by the central Finance Minister. (The budget is the account of the government’s income and expenditure for one year.) The National Assembly has the power to change the budget, i.e. to increase or reduce it, and to approve or reject it, or approve it in its original form. Generally the national budget is approved with minor changes or in its original form. In the National Assembly there is a Public Accounts Committee consisting of members of the National Assembly. It is the responsibility of this committee to scrutinise the expenditure given in the budget and present a report to the assembly. (The government does not have the power to levy any tax without the permission of the assembly.) Keeping these unlimited financial powers in view it is said that the National Assembly is the guardian of the national treasury.

4. Judicial Functions

(Under the Constitution of 1973 all powers regarding the administration of justice belong to the judiciary. The constitution has given Parliament the power to approve or not approve the appointment of judges nominated to the Supreme Court of Pakistan. For the Supreme Court, the High Courts and the Federal Shariat Court, a parliamentary committee approves the judges nominated by the Judicial Commission, which consists of eight members. The legislature, i.e. the National Assembly together with the Senate, can impeach the President of Pakistan, which is a judicial activity.)

5. Electoral Functions

(The National Assembly elects the Prime Minister of Pakistan, i.e. gives him a vote of confidence. It has the right to elect its Speaker and Deputy Speaker. This institution elects senators from Islamabad and its tribal members elect senators for the tribal areas. The National Assembly, Senate and provincial assemblies together elect the President of Pakistan. The Senate elects its Chairman and Deputy Chairman.)

6. Miscellaneous Functions

According to the constitution, the right of change or amendment in the constitution belongs to Parliament. A two-thirds majority of the total members of the National Assembly is needed to amend the constitution, and when it is sent to the other house, a two-thirds majority of the total members is needed there too. This amending bill can be presented in either house. The people have an emotional relationship and hopes attached to the legislature. In this branch the members of the assembly fully raise public problems, and members bring the problems of their areas to the notice of the government. These are the most effective forum for speaking on public problems and national affairs, because all the ministers and the Prime Minister are present in it. Besides this it would not be wrong to call it a bridge of contact between the people and the government, because on the one hand they bring public problems to the government’s notice, and on the other hand they convey government activities to the people. The National Assembly can at any time, by withdrawing confidence from the cabinet and the Prime Minister, remove them. It can reject any government draft. It can remove its Speaker and Deputy Speaker with a simple majority of total members. It can bring a notice of disqualification of any of its members to the Speaker.

(قومی اسمبلی پاکستان کے وزیرِ اعظم کا انتخاب کرتی ہے یعنی اُسے اعتماد کا ووٹ دیتی ہے۔ اسے اپنے سپیکر اور ڈپٹی سپیکر کے انتخاب کا حق حاصل ہے۔ یہ اِدارہ اسلام آباد سے سینٹرز کا انتخاب اور اسکے قبائلی ارکان قبائلی علاقے کیلئے سینٹرز کا انتخاب کرتا ہے۔ قومی اسمبلی سینٹ اور صوبائی اسمبلیوں سے مل کر صدرِ پاکستان کا انتخاب کرتی ہے۔ سینٹ اپنے چیئرمین اور ڈپٹی چیئرمین کا انتخاب کرتا ہے۔)

Functions of Executive in Pakistan

In Pakistan the executive basically consists of the President, the Prime Minister, the cabinet and government employees. According to the Constitution of 1973 the executive has several powers, which are as follows:

1. Executive Functions

Enforcing the laws made by the legislature is the responsibility of the executive. The Prime Minister of Pakistan is the head of the executive and the real ruler. The President appoints the ministers on the advice of the Prime Minister, and on the advice of the Prime Minister he removes ministers. Allotting departments (portfolios) to ministers is the Prime Minister’s power. He supervises the activities of the ministers and creates coordination between them. Giving instructions to cabinet members and ending differences between ministers is included in the Prime Minister’s responsibilities. The formulation of the administrative policy of the country is the responsibility of the executive. The enforcement of law and its supervision is the duty of the executive. The Prime Minister presides over the meetings of the cabinet and in it the Prime Minister’s voice is decisive. Although appointments to important posts of the country are made by the President of Pakistan, the real decision or advice is given by the Prime Minister.
